urls.title: Image URLs
urls.description: Direct links to JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF or AVIF images, one per line. Apify key-value store record URLs (api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/.../records/...) are read with your token. Social-network links (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, Pinterest, LinkedIn) are refused. Failed images are free.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional alternative to Image URLs, in Apify's request-list format (e.g. a file with one URL per line, or the output of another actor). Combined with Image URLs.

keyValueStoreRecords.title: Key-value store records
keyValueStoreRecords.description: Images uploaded to an Apify key-value store, as storeId/recordKey or username~store-name/recordKey, one per line. Use this to upscale your own files without hosting them anywhere.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: 2, 3 or 4: the output is this many times wider and taller. The price is the same for every scale (it depends on the input size only).

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: PNG: lossless, keeps transparency, large files. JPEG: small files, no transparency (flattened onto white). WebP: smallest files, keeps transparency, at most 16383 px per side.

quality.title: JPEG/WebP quality
quality.description: 1-100, for JPEG and WebP output. 90 is visually lossless for most images.

maxInputMegapixels.title: Max input size (megapixels)
maxInputMegapixels.description: Larger images are skipped with a free error item. 1 MP is about 1155x866 px, 2 MP about 1633x1224 px. The price is per started 0.5 MP of input, so this also caps the cost per image (2 MP = $0.04).

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger downloads are skipped with a free error item.

timeoutSecs.title: Download timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Max time to download one image.
